# Feature plan template

## Purpose and current state

Describe observed behavior, audit IDs, owner role and baseline.

## Target behavior and contracts

State inputs/outputs, authorization, financial invariants and decisions.

## Ordered tasks and dependencies

Link task records; acceptance criteria must be observable.

## Verification and rollout

Name regression, integration, device, migration and release checks as relevant.

## Migration and exclusions

Record compatibility, data repair, rollback/forward repair and deliberate exclusions.
